name: Michigan county-seat route
description: An ordered path from Keweenaw County to Monroe County through every Michigan county seat, crossing the Mackinac Bridge once. Pins are address geocodes. Edge endpoints are snapped to the road network.
attribution: Road network and some coordinates © OpenStreetMap contributors (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Other coordinate sources are linked per stop.
